pilot_guidance: Read 14 CFR 43.3(g), 43.7(f)/(h) and Appendix A(c). Ownership alone is insufficient. Certificate privileges, owned/operated aircraft, operating use, light-sport limitations and complexity matter. Ordinary pilot provisions exclude aircraft used under Parts 121, 129 or 135; specific exceptions need independent review. Never infer authorization from a selected role.

preventive_tasks.Tires — Appendix A(c)(1): Reference category for landing gear tire work, subject to the Appendix A(c) limitations and actual aircraft configuration.
preventive_tasks.Wheel bearings — Appendix A(c)(4): Reference category for wheel-bearing servicing. Confirm the scope does not involve complex assembly operations.
preventive_tasks.Lubrication — Appendix A(c)(6): Review disassembly restrictions before treating lubrication as preventive maintenance.
preventive_tasks.Oil / strainers — Appendix A(c)(23): Review oil-strainer/filter-screen and oil-service scope against current text and manufacturer data; do not assume every filter replacement qualifies.
preventive_tasks.Spark plugs — Appendix A(c)(20): Review permissible plug servicing and replacement scope against the aircraft's instructions.
preventive_tasks.Batteries — Appendix A(c)(24): Battery servicing or replacement eligibility depends on actual work and applicable limitations.
preventive_tasks.Other / custom: Identify the actual controlling Appendix A(c) item and applicable authorization. This menu is not an exhaustive legal eligibility determination.
